description: Defines a fixed connection point on a node's boundary or interior.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates a copy of this constraint.

members.name: Dx
members.description: Horizontal offset in pixels applied after relative positioning.

members.name: Dy
members.description: Vertical offset in pixels applied after relative positioning.

members.name: Perimeter
members.description: When true, the point is projected onto the node perimeter. When false, the point is inside the bounding box.

members.name: RelativeX
members.description: Relative X position (0–1) along the node width. 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge.

members.name: RelativeY
members.description: Relative Y position (0–1) along the node height. 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge.
